notes:
Lead source: inbound (developer blog + Product Hunt mention).

Pain / context:
- Early-stage B2B SaaS (in-app assistant for onboarding & contextual help). Focused on tiny latency overhead to keep chat feeling native.
- Current prototype uses hosted LLM evals (3rd-party) but they hit visible jitter on short responses. Looking for streaming + low-p95 latency.
- Primary KPI: perceived response time <200ms for short utterances; p95 target they repeatedly mentioned: <=150ms for messages <120 tokens.

Technical details heard on calls:
- Traffic profile: peak 25-40 rps across a single region (NA), typical bursty (morning/evening).
- Response patterns: many very short replies (5-30 tokens), occasional long generative answers (200-800 tokens).
- Want streaming so UI can render tokens as they arrive (no client-side polling).
- Prefer small, efficient model variants for cost (open to quantized Llama-type models or Redwood-curated small chat models).
- Concerned about prompt/cost granularities: need per-token cost visibility and examples of batching impact for short-turn workloads.

Security/compliance notes:
- Company uses GSuite + Okta. Requires SSO (SAML) for admin access and audit logging for activity.
- Data residency: not strict now, but wants clear retention controls and option to opt-out of data collection for production.

Commercial / process:
- Self‑serve discovery to start. AE engaged once they exceeded free credit/run POC. Likely to convert to hosted usage (usage-based billing).
- ARR expected small in year 1; estimates show $3k–$12k ARR if prototype scales to paid users.

Direct quotes / paraphrases from product lead:
- "Users drop off when the assistant feels laggy — even 200ms feels slow compared to native UI."
- "We want streaming first-class; batching that adds 100ms is a non-starter for short replies."

Open items / asks from SE:
- Provide example streaming integration snippet (JS/TS) that shows low-latency token streaming.
- Provide p95 latency benchmark doc for hosted_api with small chat models in NA region (sample QPS: 30 rps, median tokens 18).
- Show simple cost calc and tokenization examples for their prompt templates.

Next steps (short):
- AE to send 1‑page pricing + sample streaming snippet (by 2026-03-12).
- SE to review sample app logs once they share anonymized request traces (they expect to drop in an email).
- Schedule 30m technical call week of 2026-03-15 to walk through telemetry and discuss fallback policies.
